claim.claim-text: 1. A method of accessing a target cell (12) of an automated storage and retrieval system (1), the automated storage and retrieval system (1) comprising:

- a rail system (108,108') comprising a first set of parallel rails (110) arranged in a horizontal plane (P,P') and extending in a first direction (X), and a second set of parallel rails (111) arranged in the horizontal plane (P,P') and extending in a second direction (Y) which is orthogonal to the first direction (X), which first and second sets of rails (110, 111) form a grid pattern in the horizontal plane (P,P') comprising a plurality of adjacent grid cells (122), - a central control unit (14) configured to receive, transmit and process data signals of a plurality of container handling vehicles (2,3) for handling storage containers (106) of the automated storage and retrieval system (1), each container handling vehicle (2,3) comprising a vehicle body (101a, 201a, 301a, 601a) a wheel assembly (101b, 101c, 201b, 201c, 301b, 301c, 601b, 601c) provided on the vehicle body (101a, 201a, 301a, 601a ), the wheel assembly (101b, 101c, 201b, 201c, 301b, 301c, 601b, 601c) being configured to move the vehicle (2,3) along the rail system (108,108') in both of the first direction (X) and the second direction (Y), a vehicle control unit (15) configured to receive data signals from, transmit data signals to and process data signals of the central control unit (14), and a proximity sensor system (4) configured to detect another container handling vehicle (2,3) in the rail system (108,108') and determine whether or not the other container handling vehicle (2,3) is within a predetermined distance (D),
wherein the method comprises:

- assigning the first container handling vehicle (2) with a task that includes accessing of a target cell, which is one of the plurality of grid cells, - measuring, by means of said proximity sensor of the first container handling vehicle (2), distance to the second container vehicle (3), - transmitting, by the vehicle control unit (15) of the first container handling vehicle (2), to the central control unit (14), when said second container handling vehicle (3) is beyond predetermined distance (D), - when said second container handling vehicle (3) is beyond predetermined distance (D), determining, based on the position of the second container handling vehicle (3) relative the target cell, by means of the central control unit (14), when the first container handling vehicle is to start moving towards the target cell, and - transmitting a data signal (16) from the central control unit (14) to the vehicle control unit (15) of the first container handling vehicle (2) commanding the first container handling vehicle (2) to start moving towards the target cell (12).
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the method comprises:

- transmitting a data signal (16) from the central control unit (14) to the vehicle control unit (15) of the second container handling vehicle (3) commanding the second container handling vehicle (3) to move clear of the target cell (12) while the first container handling vehicle (2) moves towards the target cell.
3. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the method comprises:

- continuously monitoring with the proximity sensor system (4) of the first container handling vehicle (2) as it moves towards the target cell (12) to detect if the second container handling vehicle (3) is within the predetermined distance (D).

4. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the predetermined distance (D) is a distance on a plane that is defined by the first direction (X) and the second direction (Y) of the rails (110,111).
5. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the method comprises:

- continuously monitoring with the proximity sensor system (4) of the first container handling vehicle (2) as it moves towards the target cell (12) and follows the second container handling vehicle (3) moving in the same direction.
6. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the method comprises:
- discontinuing movement of the first container handling vehicle (2) if the second container handling vehicle (3) is within the predetermined distance (D).
7. An automated storage and retrieval system (1) comprising:

a vehicle body (101a, 201a, 301a, 601a) a wheel assembly (101b, 101c, 201b, 201c, 301b, 301c, 601b, 601c) provided on the vehicle body (101a, 201a, 301a, 601a), the wheel assembly (18) being configured to move the vehicle (2,3) along the rail system (108,108') in the first direction (X) and the second direction (Y), a vehicle control unit (15) configured to receive, transmit and process data signals of the central control unit (14); each of said plurality of container handling vehicles (2,3) comprises a proximity sensor system (4) configured to detect another container handling vehicle (2,3) of said plurality of container handling vehicles (2,3) and determine whether or not it is within a predetermined distance (D), wheerein the automated storage and retrieval system (1) is configured to:

- assign the first container handling vehicle (2) with a task that includes accessing of a target cell, which is one of the plurality of grid cells, - measure, by means of said proximity sensor of the first container handling vehicle (2), distance to the second container vehicle (3), - transmit, by the vehicle control unit (15) of the first container handling vehicle (2), to the central control unit (14), when said second container handling vehicle (3) is beyond predetermined distance (D), - when said second container handling vehicle (3) is beyond predetermined distance (D), determine, based on the position of the second container handling vehicle (3) relative the target cell, by means of the central control unit (14), when the first container handling vehicle is to start moving towards the target cell, and - transmit a data signal (16) from the central control unit (14) to the vehicle control unit (15) of the first container handling vehicle (2) commanding the first container handling vehicle (2) to start moving towards the target cell (12).
8. The system (1) according to claim 7, where the predetermined distance (D) is measured from a side surface (5) of a container handling vehicle (2) in a direction (X,Y) of the rails (110,111).
9. The system according to claim 8, where each container handling vehicle (2,3) comprises four vertical side surfaces (7,8,9,10):

- a first side surface (7) facing a positive first direction (X+), a second side surface (8) facing a negative first direction (X-), a third side surface (9) facing a positive second direction (Y+) and a fourth side surface (10) facing a negative second direction (Y-), wherein the positive and negative directions are opposite of each other; - and where the first side surface (7) and the second side surface (8) extend between the third side surface (9) and the fourth side surface (10) such that the side surfaces (7,8,9,10) form a rectangular cross section (11) in a horizontal plane.
10. The system (1) according to claim 9, wherein the proximity sensor system (4) comprises:

- a first part sensor system (4X+) directed outwards from the first side surface (7) in the positive first direction (X+) and being capable of detecting another container handling vehicle (2,3) within said predetermined distance (D) from the first side surface (7), and - a second part sensor system (4X-) directed outward from the second side surface (8) in the negative first direction (X-) and being capable of detecting another container handling vehicle (2,3) within said predetermined distance (D) from the second side surface (8), - a third part sensor system (4Y+) directed outwards from the third side surface (9) in the positive second direction (Y+) and being capable of detecting another container handling vehicle (2,3) within said predetermined distance (D) from the third side surface (9), and - a fourth part sensor system (4Y-) directed outwards from the fourth side surface in the negative second direction (Y-) and being capable of detecting another container handling vehicle (2,3) within said predetermined distance (D) from the fourth side surface (10).

11. The system (1) according to any of the claims 7-10, wherein the target cell is located beneath a port column of the grid and/or at an at the edge of the rail system, where the container delivery vehicle is to deliver a storage container to be picked.
12. The system (1) according to any of the claims 7-11, wherein the system is configured to:

- transmit a data signal (16) from the central control unit (14) to the vehicle control unit (15) of the second container handling vehicle (3) commanding the second container handling vehicle (3) to move clear of the target cell (12) while the first container handling vehicle (2) moves towards the target cell.
13. The system (1) according to any of the claims 7-12, wherein the system is configured to:

- continuously monitor with the proximity sensor system (4) of the first container handling vehicle (2) as it moves towards the target cell (12) to detect if the second container handling vehicle (3) is within the predetermined distance (D).

14. The system (1) according to any of the claims 7-13, wherein the system is configured to: - continuously monitor with the proximity sensor system (4) of the first container handling vehicle (2) as it moves towards the target cell (12) to detect if the second container handling vehicle (3) is within the predetermined distance (D) and follows the second container handling vehicle (3) moving in the same direction.
15. The system (1) according to any of the claims 7-14, wherein the system is configured to:
- discontinue movement of the first container handling vehicle (2) if the second container handling vehicle (3) is within the predetermined distance (D).
